name: Coordinate-Block Replacement Preserves Dismantlable Ampleness Exactly
statement: $W_E(H)$ is dismantlable ample exactly when $H$ is. More generally, relative peeling $H\searrow T$ is equivalent to $W_E(H)\searrow W_E(T)$.
proof: Each old corner deletion lifts through a binary replacement by deleting one or three fibre words, and iterating gives arbitrary blocks. Reducing all but one new coordinate sends a lifted corner chain back to the old chain after repeated images are omitted.
